info.name: FDIC Bank Data API (Beta) Demographics History API
Get Detail on Structure Change Events

params.name: filters
params.description:
The filter criteria that refines the records returned. All values must be entered in UPPERCASE.
Examples:
* Filter by State
`STATE:"VIRGINIA"`  
* Filter all but a specified value  
`!(STATE:"VIRGINIA")`  
* Filter by Date Range
`PROCDATE:[2020-01-01 TO 2020-02-01]`

params.name: search
params.description:
Flexible text search against institution records
Search supports text search and fuzzy matching, as opposed to filters that are exact matches. All values must be entered in UPPERCASE.
Examples:
* Search by Name
`NAME: Island`
* Search by Name (fuzzy match)
`NAME: Iland`
* Search by State
`STATE: VA`

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma delimited list of fields of failed financial institutions to return. All values must be entered in UPPERCASE.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Field name by which to sort returned data

params.name: sort_order
params.description: Indicator if ascending (ASC) or descending (DESC). All values must be entered in UPPERCASE.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of records to return. Default is 10 and maximum is 10,000.

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset of page to return.

params.name: agg_by
params.description: The field by which data will be aggregated. All values must be entered in UPPERCASE.

params.name: agg_term_fields
params.description: The field(s) for which aggregations will be counted for each unique term. All values must be entered in UPPERCASE.

params.name: agg_limit
params.description: The limit on how many aggregated results will be displayed

params.name: format
params.description: The format of the data to return.

params.name: download
params.description: Whether the data should be downloaded as a file.

params.name: filename
params.description: The filename to use when downloading data.
